vulnerable_code:
class ExportFilterRequest(BaseModel):
    date_from: date
    date_to: date
    event_categories: List[str]

@router.post("/api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/audit-trail/export")
async def initiate_audit_export(
    tenant_id: int,
    filters: ExportFilterRequest,
    exporter: AuditExporter = Depends(get_audit_exporter),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    job_id = await exporter.create_export_task(
        tenant_id=tenant_id,
        date_from=filters.date_from,
        date_to=filters.date_to,
        categories=filters.event_categories
    )
    return {"job_id": job_id, "status": "queued"}
diagnosis: The route accepts tenant_id from the URL path and queues an audit trail export job without verifying that current_user.tenant_id == tenant_id or that the user has tenant auditor privileges. An attacker can initiate unauthorized audit extractions for other tenants.
